members.comment:
2026-10-02 scoped native provider contract probe stage-owned-texture-filter/native.log: 144 attempted 2D/cube/volume creations across four pools, ordinary/AUTOGEN/AUTOGEN+RT/DYNAMIC usage and A8R8G8B8/DXT1/R5G6B5; 70 successes and980 filter observations. POINT/LINEAR setters succeed even on ordinary non-AUTOGEN textures. ANISOTROPIC succeeds on 2D but rejects on cube/volume (reported filter caps 03030700/03030300/03030300). NONE and enum values4..8/99/FFFFFFFF reject without changing the stored filter. Initial filter is LINEAR except SCRATCH cube returns NONE on this provider. Failed Reset makes getter return NONE and valid/invalid setters return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL; a successful Reset restores prior managed POINT state. Measurements are host-scoped, not inferred native Oblivion calls or a universal capability proof. Native filter setter/getter still remain in production; owned migration not implemented yet.

2026-10-02 contract clarification: Microsoft SetAutoGenFilterType documentation requires the corresponding D3DPTFILTERCAPS_MINFxxx bit; source admission uses cached per-kind device caps. Docs describe non-AUTOGEN controls as no-effect/NONE, but the scoped native host probe (70 creations/980 calls) instead stores POINT/LINEAR and 2D ANISOTROPIC on ordinary resources. Migration deliberately follows the measured provider behavior here, retains bootstrap initial filter (including SCRATCH cube NONE), and records this divergence rather than asserting universal behavior. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/d3d9/nf-d3d9-idirect3dbasetexture9-setautogenfiltertype and corresponding getautogenfiltertype. Exotic capable providers/mip algorithms remain unverified.

2026-10-02 completed source milestone stage-owned-texture-filter: public owned slots14/15 now use atomic owned Store filter state, cached per-kind D3DCAPS9 MINF admission and DX11 mip publication. Original getter is retained only for bootstrap inspection; foreign resources forward. Failed Reset getterNONE/setterINVALIDCALL and managed recovery preserve measured values. Release DLL and3 targeted tests passed:980 native API comparisons; zero native filter calls during owned worker controls; alias reinspection and reset;45 generated mip image comparisons max channel-byte error1; manager199checks/inspection109checks. No deployment. Native texture COM factories and dirty controls remain; unusual capable-provider filters/mip algorithms still unverified. V233 installed DLL unchanged; High INI explicitly set by user.

2026-10-02 source stage-owned-texture-dirty: owned AddDirtyRect/AddDirtyBox now validate/copy caller arguments and atomically update owned dirty metadata without native control calls. Release renderer and2 targeted checks passed:1872native result comparisons plus exact DX11 2D/cube/volume partial-transfer pixels, held-lock, invalid-pointer and Reset cases; manager199checks. Test exposed a real reset-publication bug also affecting new LOD/filter setters: CPU control commits must succeed while GPU replay is already pending, keeping publicationLost set until Runtime Lookup replays latest controls/data. Fix preserves the replay fence; it does not authorize stale GPU data. Recovery test proves filter/dirty CPU commits then actual DX11 replay; LOD value/replay-fence preservation also checked. Initial test-only whole-region normalization mismatch corrected separately. No deployment. Native texture COM allocation/bootstrap and GDI remain dependencies; no general backend-completion/suppression claim.

[Host shader API evidence 2026-10-02; stage-shader-token-capture/native.log, not an Oblivion call-site discovery] Twelve valid VS/PS model 1/2/3 cases preserve complete original bytecode, including literal 0000FFFF words inside DEF immediate constants and COMMENT payloads. GetFunction with physically sufficient output storage returned S_OK/full exact bytecode/intact following guard for incoming sizes 0,1,required-1,required,required+4,UINT_MAX (72 reads). This local provider treats the size as output for these cases. Duplicate creations from identical words produced distinct live COM identities. Failed Reset returned INVALIDCALL for both existing VS/PS GetFunction and new creation; incoming size=777 remained unchanged. Initial hand-authored VS1 fixture without DCL was rejected INVALIDCALL; adding its input DCL made it valid. Native pointer capture was found to search raw words for END; token-length framing is required so comment/constant data cannot truncate shaders. Capturing framing is not opcode/register/capability legality validation.

[Renderer capture fix validated 2026-10-02, stage-shader-token-capture] Raw-word END search has been replaced in source by bounded SM1 operand-count / SM2+ encoded-length / COMMENT-length framing. Capture and publication registry share this scanner. Release build plus shader publication registry CPU, actual live-hook CPU and native/DX11 pixel/recovery WARP checks passed. Exact public capture/publication comparison preserved all 569 stored shader files (corpus manifest) and 12 native-tested fixtures; truncation, trailing-program and guard-page checks passed. This is transport validation only: shader factory opcode/register/capability admission is still unfinished and native shader allocation remains active. No deployment or live Oblivion suppression/FPS claim.

definition:
struct TESObjectLIGH_DecodedLayout
{
unsigned __int8 base_00[112];
int time_70; ///< Native LIGH time/duration field.
unsigned int radius_74; ///< Native light radius; passed in EAX to NiPointLight_ConfigureAttenuationFromLightRadius.
unsigned int colorRgb_78; ///< Packed RGB color used to seed NiLight diffuse/specular color.
unsigned int lightFlags_7C; ///< Oblivion LIGH DATA flags. Retail game consumers prove: 0x02 Can carry gates activation/pickup; 0x04 Negative negates point-light RGB; 0x20 Off by default suppresses the normal non-actor attached-light path; 0x08/0x40 select Flicker/Flicker Slow; 0x80/0x100 select Pulse/Pulse Slow. Construction Set Light dialog 156 supplies the exact labels Dynamic=0x01, Can carry=0x02, Negative=0x04, Flicker=0x08, Off by default=0x20, Flicker Slow=0x40, Pulse=0x80, Pulse Slow=0x100, Spot Light=0x200, Spot Shadow=0x400. The decoded retail reference-light registration at 0x004D80C0 does not read this flag word and explicitly sets ShadowSceneLight projector mode false and renderGateOverride_120=0; the editor Spot labels therefore are not proof of an active retail projected-shadow producer.
float falloffExponent_80; ///< Falloff exponent field decoded from the Oblivion LIGH record and projector path.
float projectorFovDegrees_84; ///< Projector field of view in degrees; native projected-light setup clamps it before use.
float fade_88; ///< Fade/dimmer base loaded from and saved to the FNAM subrecord. Seeds NiLight::m_fDimmer and retargets AttachedLightPayload_Decoded::targetDimmer_04.
void *soundForm_8C; ///< Linked sound form loaded from the SNAM subrecord.
}
